findings.claim: A real tool-policy allow-list gate exists (worker_policy.is_tool_allowed_for_worker denies review/approve/critical ops incl. execute_python/execute_vex/delete/render, fails closed on unknown tools) but is DISABLED on the interactive artist path: the panel builds the worker with enforce_worker_policy=False, so _execute_tool_block skips the gate (guarded by `if self._enforce_worker_policy`). The panel bridge also nullifies consent (auto-approve True, HumanGate _gate=None). Terminus is arbitrary code: _handle_execute_python compiles+exec()s the LLM `content` with {hou, __builtins__} — full builtins, no import filter. Net: on the path users chat through, a prompt-injected execute_python runs ungated. The gate that would stop it ships built-but-off.

Sanitize-SQ is a harness-only PowerShell single-quote escaper (sanitize_sq doubles the apostrophe for a PS single-quoted literal). Whole-repo grep: every call site is under harness/** (orchestrate.ps1, quote-safe.ps1, tests); ZERO under python/synapse/**. It wraps ZERO NL-to-node engine entry points. PROGRAM.md B3 row lists 'Sanitize-SQ shipped (W6)' as the engine NL-to-node injection defense — a category error; the engine path has no Sanitize-SQ coverage at all.

Zero retry on any of the five backends. Each stream() issues exactly one conn.request/getresponse in a try/finally that only closes the connection; a 429/5xx becomes RuntimeError with no Retry-After honoring, and a transport error (socket.timeout/ConnectionError) propagates uncaught. Uniform across all five.

Only the Anthropic parser converts a mid-stream server `error` event into a loud RuntimeError. Gemini and the OpenAI-shape parsers (nemotron/ollama/custom) have NO in-band error handling — a mid-stream server error is skipped as non-JSON (logger.debug) or ignored, and the turn ends as end_turn with partial/empty content, nothing surfaced. Nemotron unclosed-<think> truncation drops reasoning with only logger.warning, yielding an empty visible turn. Breaks the D3 loud-surface discipline for 4 of 5 backends.

Fully offline there is no failover and no transport retry: a provider stream/transport error ends the turn via stream_error.emit; the worker's F2 retry_breaker is a loop-abandon guard for repeated identical TOOL failures, not an HTTP retry or provider switch. Ollama is the only local-capable backend, but its default row glm-5:cloud is a CLOUD tag metered by ollama.com, so the default 'local' pick also fails offline; only a genuinely-local tag with a running daemon works.

Additional argument-content-unchecked NL-to-node seams: create_node passes the LLM-supplied name verbatim to parent_node.createNode(node_type, name) with existence-check only — the repo _safe_node_name sanitizer is not applied. set_parm validates only NaN/Inf then passes node path, parm name, and value verbatim to hou parm.set.

Key location classes (values never echoed): claude=hou.secure cred store (inert on H21/H22) OR ANTHROPIC_API_KEY env OR <repo>/.env PLAINTEXT (set_anthropic_key.bat appends; .env gitignored). gemini=GEMINI_API_KEY/GOOGLE_API_KEY env. nemotron=NVIDIA_API_KEY env. ollama=OLLAMA_API_KEY env or none. custom=user-named env var; only the NAME lives in panel_settings.json, never the value. No key value is ever logged (host/auth: 'No logging is emitted on fallback'). Each key egresses only to its provider host, but nemotron/ollama/custom base URLs are env/config-settable, so the Bearer key follows the configured host with no vendor-host pin.
HTTP timeout value asymmetry with no in-code rationale: claude/gemini 60s vs nemotron/ollama/custom 120s. Module constants, no env override or per-call parameter.

Confirmed NON-issues (first-hand positive evidence, recorded so they are not re-litigated): (1) NO no-timeout hang class — every backend passes a bounded socket timeout to its connection (60s claude/gemini, 120s nemotron/ollama/custom). (2) NO cross-backend failover — by design (base.py D3 no-silent-fallback); a stream failure surfaces loud as stream_error. (3) Routing is EXPLICIT SELECTION, not cost/capability routing — the tier_candidates_for capability classifier is latent (zero non-test consumers); cost is display-only ('Cost never appears here. A price cannot make anything green'). (4) No key value is ever logged.
